sources: https://tnstateparks.com/parks/standing-stone/camping (read 2026-11-25): alert 'Campground Undergoing Renovation / Starting July 7, 2025, the campground at Standing Stone State Park will undergo renovations. Parkwide calendar view (POST, plain curl) for the two weeks from 2026-12-15, 2027-05-11, 2027-07-13 and 2027-10-05: all 36 campsite rows 'Unavailable' every night, no price shown. values.note: 34 water/electric back-in sites with posted RV lengths of 42-71 ft, plus two accessible sites (24H, 25H). Site 21 also has sewer. RVs over 30 ft must come in from Hwy 52; a one-lane bridge on Hwy 136 bars them from the south.

note: Tennessee State Parks campground in Standing Stone State Forest near Hilham, on the Cumberland Plateau: two wooded loops north of Standing Stone Lake. --Claude
summary: Standing Stone: park pages, reserve.tnstateparks.com notice + calendar (4 windows) + per-site data + map, Esri. Still closed for renovation ('expected to last until late 2026'), every site Unavailable through Oct 2027, so no rate can be read. 36 sites (34 W/E 20/30/50 A, one sewer), 42-71 ft back-ins, showers/dump/Wi-Fi, year-round when open. Pin ~700 m off (on the cabin peninsula).
